title: Principal Product Manager, Orbit
description_text:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.
An overview of this role
As Principal Product Manager, Orbit, you'll define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for GitLab's software lifecycle context graph. Orbit connects source code and software development lifecycle data into a structured map of systems, relationships, dependencies, and ownership. You'll help engineers, software leaders, and artificial intelligence (AI) agents understand how teams build software and how changes affect the systems around it.
You'll shape Orbit from its underlying graph model and query experiences through customer value, pricing, packaging, launch, and adoption. This role combines technical product leadership with building a business around software lifecycle context. You'll balance foundational platform work with near-term customer needs, working directly with technical customers and senior Engineering and Design leaders.
You'll join Anand Ahire's product organization and partner across Product, Engineering, Design, Product Marketing, Sales, Solutions Engineering, and Customer Success, including the teams building GitLab Duo and the broader AI-powered development, security, and operations (DevSecOps) platform.
What you'll do
Define Orbit's multi-year vision and roadmap across graph models and ontology, ingestion and indexing, query and retrieval, developer and agent interfaces, governance, and enterprise readiness. Shape how Orbit works across GitLab.com, Self-Managed, Dedicated, GitLab Duo Agent Platform, MCP-based external agents, APIs, and developer tooling.
Turn complex platform opportunities into customer problems, measurable outcomes, and investment decisions. Use evidence to decide where to invest, iterate, partner, or stop.
Partner with Engineering and Design on architecture and implementation tradeoffs across graph data models, indexing, query systems, application programming interfaces (APIs), Model Context Protocol (MCP), authorization, and scale.
Use AI tools such as Claude Code and GitLab to investigate problems, explore code and data, prototype concepts, and create or review merge requests when that's the fastest way to learn.
Lead discovery with developers, engineering leaders, platform teams, security teams, and technical executives to validate needs around dependencies, ownership, change impact, vulnerability exposure, pipeline health, and software delivery risk. Build repeatable feedback into roadmap decisions and help customers understand the value of connected graph context over disconnected searches or API calls.
Define target customers, priority use cases, differentiated value, and the path to product-market fit. Partner with Product Marketing, Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Pricing, and Finance on positioning, packaging, pricing, launch, adoption, and expansion.
Develop business cases and track adoption, retention, usage, customer value, and revenue outcomes. Support executive briefings, analyst conversations, customer workshops, and field enablement.
Align teams and executive leaders around clear recommendations and tradeoffs without relying on direct authority. Mentor other product managers, share practical frameworks, and represent GitLab's product vision in customer and industry conversations.
What you'll bring
Experience owning complex technical products or platforms at Staff, Principal, or equivalent scope, with a track record of defining vision and roadmaps across multiple teams.
Deep technical fluency in one or more relevant areas, such as developer tools, DevOps, software delivery, data platforms, distributed systems, knowledge graphs, search, APIs, AI infrastructure, or agentic systems.
The ability to work credibly with engineers on architecture, data models, APIs, scale, reliability, and security.
Business judgment and experience in market assessment, product strategy, pricing, packaging, business cases, or commercialization of technical products.
Experience taking a product, platform, or category from early concept through launch, customer adoption, and iteration.
A customer-first approach and the ability to build trusted relationships with technical practitioners, engineering leaders, architects, and executives.
Clear written and verbal communication, with experience explaining complex ideas, influencing across functions, and resolving competing priorities in ambiguous work.
Practical experience using AI tools in product work, including exploring code and data, prototyping workflows, and creating or reviewing merge requests. You take ownership, learn quickly, and move between strategy and implementation detail.
About the team
In GitLab's Analytics organization, we focus on making Orbit's context available through GitLab experiences, developer tools, MCP, APIs, and the command-line interface (CLI).
Our challenge is to turn complex, connected data into useful, trustworthy context for engineers and agents. You'll work with engineering and cross-functional partners who value technical rigor, clear product thinking, rapid learning, and direct customer contact. As part of GitLab's all-remote organization, we collaborate asynchronously across regions, with a focus on transparency, written communication, and clear decisions.
The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our benefits and equity. Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.
United States Salary Range
$203,200—$345,600 USD
How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees
Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
Flexible Paid Time Off
Team Member Resource Groups
Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
Growth and Development Fund
Parental Leave
Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.
Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.
Privacy Policy: Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.
GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know during the recruiting process.
